title: The Brazilian military dictatorship
summary: Brazil under military rule, established on 1 April 1964 by a coup of the armed forces against President João Goulart and lasting twenty-one years, until 15 March 1985. Wikidata gives the start as a day and the end only as a year; the day of the end is the English article’s. The period is held here so that the events of those twenty-one years the atlas already carries have something to be part of — and so that the coup that created the regime is not filed inside it.
regionNote: A regime has no single point on the map, so the lane is given rather than derived: Brazil’s.
